upstream.timeline: past radar frames at ten-minute intervals

differences: The new adapter keeps each tile as a raw artifact and derives EPSG:4326 Web Mercator pixel-center coordinates.

The legacy adapter requested 256px WebP tiles with color=255 and transformed the red byte channel without a provider-backed physical mapping. That encoding is not reused; the new adapter requests 512px PNG tiles with color scheme 2 and decodes the official Universal Blue RGBA table directly to dBZ.
The new adapter has no global configuration, object-store side effect, or legacy merged-image output.
evidence: official public API live smoke on 2026-09-18 and 2026-09-20

blocked_reasons: Old red-channel arithmetic was applied offline to the current color=2, 512px PNG fixture: output 1024x1024, 22 gray values, 99.10% zero. The pinned old route uses color=255, 256px WebP; no same-frame old gray baseline exists, so compatibility is unverified.
